$comment: SkyyRose V2 gap-closure procedure. Evidence is produced during each phase, not after the build.
candidate_rule: Every phase operates on one candidate_id; any source mutation invalidates downstream evidence.
completion_rule: A phase is complete only when implementation, evidence, independent review, and rollback notes exist. UNKNOWN or UNVERIFIED never becomes PASS by omission.

phases.name: Freeze candidate and inventory the truth
actions: Create candidate_id from commit SHA and UTC timestamp
Record changed-file ownership and exclude unrelated worktree edits
Snapshot catalog, image manifest, theme/plugin versions, and tool versions
Open a gap ledger with one row per unresolved acceptance ID
acceptance: P0-01 candidate ID is present on every evidence record
P0-02 all unresolved gaps have an owner and status
P0-03 unrelated worktree changes are excluded

phases.name: Bind product, variation, media, and rights truth
actions: Build SKU→product→variation→media mapping
Replace hard-coded selectors with live variation IDs
Normalize instock/backorder/preorder/outofstock/coming-soon/unavailable
Create shot manifest with asset_id, SKU refs, rights record, crop family, mobile fallback, review_after
Fail closed on unknown or interim media
acceptance: P1-01 every purchasable card has a real product/variation ID
P1-02 every media frame resolves to the intended SKU
P1-03 every availability state has a truthful label and CTA
P1-04 interim or expired media cannot ship
stop_if: client projection disagrees with server authority

phases.name: Implement the component and page state contracts
actions: Implement product-card View Product/Add to Bag decision
Implement accessible quick-view with full-PDP fallback
Implement URL-backed filters/query state and no-results recovery
Implement ten-frame PDP media with graceful missing-frame fallback
Implement cart/checkout/order/account/returns/service flows against canonical action responses
Implement extension pages only where provider and policy contracts exist
acceptance: P2-01 simple and variable products behave correctly
P2-02 quick view traps/restores focus
P2-03 PDP price/media/availability update with variation
P2-04 cart/checkout actions are idempotent and server-validated
P2-05 order/account/returns/service ownership is enforced

phases.name: Implement responsive, motion, and fallback behavior
actions: Implement 390/768/1440 transformations
Limit each route to one showpiece and approved properties
Cancel motion on route change, unmount, visibility, resize, Escape, and preference change
Provide DOM-first no-WebGL/video/audio fallbacks
Keep all commerce controls native and reachable without motion
acceptance: P3-01 no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/1440
P3-02 reduced-motion preserves facts and action order
P3-03 no-WebGL path is complete
P3-04 focus and touch cancellation are deterministic
P3-05 LCP/CLS/INP/FPS/bytes meet contract budgets

phases.name: Prove WooCommerce, payment, and service journeys
actions: Run simple/variable/preorder/backorder/out-of-stock fixtures
Run concurrent cart and checkout submissions
Test payment success, redirect, failure, pending, cancellation, and retry
Test guest and authenticated order ownership
Test returns, contact, appointment, gift, loyalty, and waitlist eligibility
Compare classic and block paths where both are supported
acceptance: P4-01 no duplicate order under retry
P4-02 stock/price changes reconcile before payment
P4-03 guest data remains private
P4-04 every failed journey has retry and recovery
P4-05 policy version shown matches current source

phases.name: Run browser, accessibility, and performance proof
actions: Run keyboard journeys through every critical path
Run screen-reader announcements and focus restoration
Run reduced-motion, forced-colors, 200% zoom, and touch checks
Capture default/loading/empty/error/unavailable/success states
Run Lighthouse and performance budgets at all required viewports
acceptance: P5-01 no critical accessibility violations
P5-02 all critical controls have names and 44px targets
P5-03 live-region messages are unique and useful
P5-04 required viewport/state captures exist
P5-05 performance budgets pass or have an approved exception

phases.name: Run independent visual, security, and content review
actions: Hide logo and copy for recognition review
Compare route rhythm against anti-generic rules
Verify claims, credits, rights, localization, and RTL behavior
Run security review for forms, uploads, auth, payment, and provider boundaries
Record independent reviewer and no-self-approval relationship
acceptance: P6-01 logo-off score meets threshold
P6-02 no hard-fail visual patterns
P6-03 no unsupported claims or rights gaps
P6-04 security review has no unresolved critical findings
P6-05 reviewer is independent from implementer

phases.name: Package, rehearse rollback, and issue the decision
actions: Rebuild generated assets from source
Install into a clean target and rerun verifier
Rehearse migration and rollback without production writes
Create immutable archive with hashes and candidate ID
Issue PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED; PASS means founder-review-ready only
acceptance: P7-01 clean install passes
P7-02 generated parity passes
P7-03 rollback rehearsal passes
P7-04 all required evidence is candidate-bound
P7-05 founder decision is recorded
